definitions.explanation: A rack or basket placed next to the kitchen sink where washed dishes are placed to drip dry. A standard item in Japanese kitchens.

examples.japanese: {洗|あら}った{皿|さら}を{水切|みずき}りかごに{置|お}く。
examples.english: Put the washed plates on the dish drainer.

examples.japanese: {水切|みずき}りかごがいっぱいになった。
キッチンが{狭|せま}いので、{水切|みずき}りかごの{代|か}わりに{水切|みずき}りマットを{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: Since the kitchen is small, I use a drying mat instead of a dish drainer.

notes:
{水切|みずき}り (draining water) + かご (basket). In Japanese kitchens, many people air-dry dishes rather than towel-drying them.

Alternatives to the traditional basket:
- {水切|みずき}りマット — absorbent drying mat
- {水切|みずき}りラック — metal drying rack
- {水切|みずき}りトレー — drying tray

Like the {三角|さんかく}コーナー, some minimalist households choose not to use a {水切|みずき}りかご to save counter space.
